name: Ugly
overview: Scripture reveals that all people are created in the image of God and are wonderfully made, as seen in Genesis 1:27 and Psalms 139:14, affirming the inherent value of every individual regardless of outward appearance. The account of Jacob seeing Leah, described as 'tender eyed' and contrasted with Rachel's beauty (Genesis 29:17), illustrates that physical attractiveness does not determine worth or God's purpose. Wisdom literature cautions against valuing mere external beauty without discretion (Proverbs 11:22) and warns against lusting after beauty (Proverbs 6:25), emphasizing the importance of inner character over outward looks.
